verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser is an API-first cloud browser service. You start sessions and agent tasks with a single API call, control them programmatically through official SDKs, and connect existing Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP scripts over a WebSocket endpoint. There is also a CLI (`hx`), so it runs unattended without any local UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
